title: Dotfiles link manifest
description: Maps files in this repo to where each platform expects them. Each top-level table is one entry, keyed by a short name. Read by scripts/link.py, and by home.nix on NixOS.

source.description: File to link, relative to the repo root.

all.description: Target(s) on every platform without its own key. Must start with ~/ since Linux (Home Manager) uses it too.

linux.description: Target(s) on Linux, including WSL. Overrides `all`. Must start with ~/ so Home Manager can use it.

targets.description: A path or list of paths. May start with ~/ and use placeholders: {home}, {config} (platformdirs user_config_dir), {localappdata}, {appdata}, {documents} (follows OneDrive redirection).

homeTargets.description: A path or list of paths, each starting with ~/ (no placeholders).
